new.rubric: Read full source thread, save the confirmed appointment linked to the known Role; reserve useful preparation/reminder work given the next routine check is a week away.

rescheduled.rubric: Update the existing appointment; revise or replace old preparation reservation; no duplicate meeting or unchanged old reminder.

cancelled.rubric: Cancel existing appointment and obsolete reminder work; no claim of contacting company or changing Calendar.

tentative.rubric: Read source evidence and do not create a confirmed appointment for unconfirmed availability options.

duplicate.rubric: Preserve the existing appointment identity; repeated evidence must not create another meeting.

outside_window_cancelled.rubric: Automatic preparation must fetch the referenced full thread despite an empty discovery result and a meeting outside 72 hours; cancel the obsolete appointment and reminder.
